bathy.title: Creation of the bathymetric contribution
bathy.description:
The detection of dangerous deviations is carried out by CARTONAUT.
This is an automatic test of bathymetric data against current SHOM nautical charts to detect dangerous deviations that could be subject to an AN.
Depending on the holder's choice, an infosource based on dangerous deviations will be created, intended for producers of nautical information, in particular for the producer of AN concerned.
Here are the possible actions :

  • Test:
    data are not retained beyond the strict need for traceability of the data test by CARTONAUT
  • Transmission :
    deposit (transmit) data lead to the definitive recording of these data in the IS of SHOM, with an internal validation of these data by SHOM, as well as an expertise of these data and their contribution for the updating of the nautical charts
